source_attribution.institution: CNR Institute of Polar Sciences and OGS
source_attribution.title: S1 Mooring ADCP data @ 420m looking upward

scientific_review: These are actual provider velocity profiles retained raw before parsing, not a literature depth summary or model field. All original selected rows stay in the native CSV.
There are 48 temporally correlated half-hourly profiles, not 144 independent observations. Threshold variants share the same profiles and original case budget.
Depth coordinates are negative despite positive-down and EPSG:5831 declarations. No sign reversal, absolute depth, or shallow/deep endpoint interpretation is admitted.

Horizontal source orientation is not independently verified. Core-relative dot products and speeds are invariant under a common horizontal rotation within a profile, but do not establish geographic current direction or water-mass identity.
The source coordinate is nominal, calculated from mooring diagram and other sensors; sampled bin-coordinate spans do not establish true instantaneous physical layer thickness or an uncertainty bound.
Only provider QC1 finite pairs qualify. Missing/QC bins, vertical gaps and domain edges terminate connectivity. Threshold brackets are not interpolated.

A connected bin-center span is the span of the sampled threshold-selected run. Physical layers may extend beyond sampled/QC support; no full extent or physical bottom inferred. A single bin produces null span, not a zero-depth current.
The example 200m span reaches a sampled boundary and stops at QC/missing data at its other end. It does not establish an exact 200m physical layer.
S1 is offshore southwest Svalbard in a region of interacting flows. No named-current attribution is admitted; this packet is not assigned to West Spitsbergen or copied to Norwegian/branch owners.
The 0.05/0.10/0.20m/s thresholds are methodological variants, not confidence limits or seasonal ranges. Tides are not removed. One July day is not an annual range.
The inherited ledger raw_sha256 identifies the original metadata; native_raw_sha256 identifies the CSV. raw_bytes is cumulative across both operations.
The original S1 case is closed with unused operations surrendered. Do not acquire another instrument/month/format under a renewed budget or replay these source/artifact targets.
